QUESTION:
In which release did the default of `compactor.worker_threads` change, and what was it before?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0240] config | compactor.worker_threads (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `compactor.worker_threads` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Number of worker threads used by the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `8` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | compactor |
| Unit | threads |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `compactor.worker_threads` only if you observe problems with the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[compactor]
worker_threads = 8
```

---

[d0929] config | compactor.worker_threads | version 4.x
# `compactor.worker_threads`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of worker threads used by the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `2` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | compactor |
| Unit | threads |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `compactor.worker_threads` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[compactor]
worker_threads = 2
```

# `replicator.worker_threads`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | replicator |
| Unit | threads |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `replicator.worker_threads` only if you observe problems with the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[replicator]
worker_threads = 1
```

response.content: The default changed in PaderQueue 4.0. Before that, it was `8` threads.
